svg.title: Away from the coasts, only the Great Lakes and a few deep rivers bring large-ship routes inland

cc:Work.dc:title: Away from the coasts, only the Great Lakes and a few deep rivers bring large-ship routes inland
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of the lower 48 states shaded by distance to the nearest large-ship route: dark bands along the coasts, the Great Lakes, the Hudson, Columbia, Sacramento, and lower Mississippi rivers; light in the interior.
